correctness.rationale: Every line is uniquely covered by one of six reduced-row-echelon Grassmann charts. Exact restriction coefficients prove two charts empty, give separable nine-root additive polynomials on two charts and four fixed lines on the others. For nonzero F3 parameters, the quadratic relation on Frobenius is irreducible with fourth power -I and eighth power I, proving all eight-cycles and the exact zeta. Finite étaleness follows from normal bundle O(-2) on a smooth K3. The independent standard-library verifier checked six symbolic identities and exhaustive F3/F9 counts, but finite checks are not used to infer the infinite tower.
